existing_helpers.inspection: Its references/build code aggregates imported record paths and explicit family/catalog links. It expressly labels shared-report links navigation-only; it is not a per-source-span adjudication selector and cannot resolve this bug by itself.
existing_helpers.current_selection_logic: The DE and earlier CN/CW selectors are transient per-batch scripts, not one tested repository helper. CN/CW recursively gather all source IDs/overlaps and likewise need completed-versus-open separation before reuse. No transient machine path is published here.

smallest_proposed_change.artifact: One small reusable read-only source-review receipt normalizer and bounded query helper; no new registry/schema migration or reimplementation of semantic ideas.
smallest_proposed_change.input: Explicit curation JSON files and candidate source_id/path/line/end/source_hash metadata.
smallest_proposed_change.normalize: Evidence dict -> singleton list; list -> dict elements; absent -> empty. Read full_block_read/full_selected_span_read/full_report_context_read as read-status aliases. Retain original JSON pointer, decision text, file hash, evidence hash and exact source ID. Do not treat cards.evidence or selection-only/excluded rows as adjudications.
smallest_proposed_change.decision_state: Map known completed disposition names explicitly to assessed, scope_comparison_open and other known unresolved states to pending; unknown decisions remain needs_schema_review. Reading completion and semantic comparison completion are separate fields.
query_outputs: exact_id_assessed: completed explicit decision for this exact source ID, with fresh source binding; avoid redoing that source decision.
exact_id_pending: prior read exists but scope comparison unfinished; resume rather than mark done.
prior_full_read_contains_span: same fresh source hash and full containment under another ID; reuse existing reading and inspect proposition-to-card coverage explicitly, without granting coverage.
partial_overlap_or_quote_only: navigation hint only; candidate remains eligible for its unreviewed content.
stale_or_unknown_receipt: preserve pointer but do not suppress selection.
smallest_proposed_change.default_action: Route exact_id_assessed to an existing-decision receipt instead of repeating preparation. Put contained siblings into a fast proposition-comparison queue. Neither output is a scientific/semantic exclusion gate; retain the original assertions, open comparisons and decision provenance.

decision_utility: The next batch can skip repeated primary preparation, yet still notice an independently addressable conjunction hidden inside an already quoted report. It also resumes genuine pending comparisons rather than losing them behind a broad done set.

tests: Same decision/evidence represented as object or one-item list yields identical normalized receipt.
Exact source ID with completed decision is assessed; identical source ID with scope_comparison_open is pending despite full_block_read=true.
Different ID fully contained in a completed full-read span yields prior_full_read_contains_span, never exact_id_assessed.
Partial overlap, ordinary card quote, selection reservation and excluded-pointer records do not suppress a candidate.
Changed source hash returns stale; unknown decision or missing freshness metadata fails open to manual review.
Regression from these13 DE receipts:13 containment hints,0 exact-ID suppressions; existing14th Pass341 full-claim decision remains separate.
A fully quoted report whose older card omits the explicit marker-reset assertion remains a proposition-comparison task, even when its central handoff claim is addressed.
minimal_test_plan.stop_condition: If adapters require broad status inference or a new semantic database, stop expansion and implement only the known AL/AO/BE/current source_reassessments shapes. No NLP or blanket path coverage.

limits: No helper implementation, test execution or operational mutation. Two bounded source-to-claim comparisons were performed as diagnostic examples; no blanket review of all thirteen sibling propositions.
The13 spans are proven previously read/contained through audit metadata, not independently certified semantically covered here.
The current DE amendment removes14 including one separate Pass341 full-proposition comparison, not14 manifestations of the evidence-shape bug.
